hints.title: Expression String Partitioning
hints.text: The expression is num1 + num2. Split at the plus sign into left string L and right string R.

hints.title: Parenthesis Placement Positions
hints.text: Placing "(" at index i in L divides L into a multiplier L[:i] (or 1 if empty) and term L[i:].

hints.title: Right Parenthesis Placement
hints.text: Placing ")" at index j in R divides R into term R[:j] and multiplier R[j:] (or 1 if empty).

hints.title: Exhaustive Parenthesis Evaluation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def minimizeResult(self, expression: str) -> str:
        L, R = expression.split("+")
        min_val = float("inf")
        best_expr = ""
        for i in range(len(L)):
            m1 = int(L[:i]) if i > 0 else 1
            a = int(L[i:])
            for j in range(1, len(R) + 1):
                b = int(R[:j])
                m2 = int(R[j:]) if j < len(R) else 1
                val = m1 * (a + b) * m2
                if val < min_val:
                    min_val = val
                    best_expr = f"{L[:i]}({L[i:]}+{R[:j]}){R[j:]}"
        return best_expr
```

complexity.notes: Expression length is at most 10, so at most 25 combinations are evaluated.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: No naive pitfall since inputs are tiny, but clean arithmetic factoring is required.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate exhaustively tries all placement pairs and tracks minimal product.
